verifiedQueries.name: store_sales_by_category_year
verifiedQueries.question: What are store sales by item category and year?
verifiedQueries.sql: SELECT i.i_category, d.d_year, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales FROM czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.store_sales ss JOIN czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.item i ON ss.ss_item_sk=i.i_item_sk JOIN czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk GROUP BY i.i_category,d.d_year

verifiedQueries.name: inventory_by_warehouse_item
verifiedQueries.question: What inventory quantity is on hand by warehouse and item?
verifiedQueries.sql: SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, i.i_item_id, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS quantity_on_hand FROM czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.inventory inv JOIN czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk=w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.item i ON inv.inv_item_sk=i.i_item_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name,i.i_item_id

verifiedQueries.name: web_sales_by_category_year
verifiedQueries.question: What are web sales by item category and year?
verifiedQueries.sql: SELECT i.i_category, d.d_year, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales FROM czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.web_sales ws JOIN czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.item i ON ws.ws_item_sk=i.i_item_sk JOIN czcli.cz_sv_tpcds_sf1_1789702136159.date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk GROUP BY i.i_category,d.d_year
